sub_answers.text: After the breakup of Yugoslavia and the proclamation of independence in late winter 1992, the Bosnian Football Association (N/FSBiH) applied for membership with FIFA and UEFA. [d55965203s4p0] Due to the outbreak of the Bosnian War in April 1992, no games were played in the 1992–93 season. [d55965203s4p0] In late 1993, some parts of the country re-launched football competitions with reduced scope. [d55965203s4p0] Football competition under N/FSBiH auspices did not resume until the 1995–96 season, when the Bosnian First League was officially launched. [d55965203s4p0]
